zh.title: 刚果（金）Haut-Uélé：Watsa金矿武装袭击致一名中国公民与一名警察死亡
zh.summary: 11月16日Watsa辖区Ndiyo金矿区发生武装袭击，当地媒体19日报道一名中国公民与一名刚果（金）警察遇害，疑似黄金被劫。
zh.body: 事实：Provinces 26和Forum des As于2026年11月19日报道，11月16日约07:00，Haut-Uélé省Watsa辖区Mari-Minza的Ndiyo采金区发生武装袭击，一名中国公民和一名刚果（金）警察遇害。两家媒体均引述当地民间组织负责人Célestin Kolongbe，称袭击者带走一箱黄金。分析：黄金被劫与人员遇害同时出现，倾向于有组织矿区暴力抢劫假设；针对特定人员的选择性袭击需在调查中排除或证实。经营影响：金矿现场、黄金交接环节和人员固定行程可能形成高后果暴露。建议核对Watsa周边项目中方员工与承包商位置，专项审批涉事区域黄金转运和外勤，调整可预测的交接时间及保护方式。指标：警方调查、被劫黄金数量与经营主体、同类案件频率、警力与黄金运输安排变化。核实等级：两家媒体报道，均基于同一民间组织线索。来源：https://provinces26rdc.com/haut-uele-un-ressortissant-chinois-et-un-policier-tues-dans-une-attaque-armee-dans-un-carre-minier/；https://www.forumdesas.cd/index.php/haut-uele-un-chinois-et-un-policier-tues-dans-une-attaque-armee

en.title: DR Congo Haut-Uélé: Chinese national and police officer killed in Watsa gold-mine attack
en.summary: Local media reported on 19 November that an armed attack at Ndiyo in Watsa on 16 November killed one Chinese national and one Congolese police officer; gold was reportedly stolen.
en.body: Facts: Provinces 26 and Forum des As reported on 19 November 2026 that armed men attacked the Ndiyo gold-mining area in Mari-Minza chiefdom, Watsa territory, Haut-Uélé, around 07:00 on 16 November, killing one Chinese national and one Congolese police officer. Both reports cite local civil-society coordinator Célestin Kolongbe, who said the attackers removed a container of gold. Assessment: The reported theft alongside the killings favors the working hypothesis of organized mine-site robbery; deliberately targeting particular personnel remains an alternative for investigators. Operational impact: Gold custody and handover arrangements, predictable personnel movement and site protection are relevant exposures. Management: Account for Chinese employees and contractors near Watsa, subject gold transfers and non-essential visits in the affected area to special approval, review custody handovers and local police information. Indicators: Investigative findings, quantity stolen and mine operator, recurrence at nearby sites, changes in policing and gold transport practices. Verification: Two local reports citing the same civil-society source. Sources: https://provinces26rdc.com/haut-uele-un-ressortissant-chinois-et-un-policier-tues-dans-une-attaque-armee-dans-un-carre-minier/; https://www.forumdesas.cd/index.php/haut-uele-un-chinois-et-un-policier-tues-dans-une-attaque-armee
